records.Critical Pose Anchors: Relaxed floor sit with one knee raised, one leg folded, and face supported by hand
records.Forbidden Variants: Do not make both legs straight or both knees symmetrical
records.Mirror / Left-Right Rule: Preserve raised-knee side and face-support hand
records.Prompt-Ready Pose Definition: Female model seated on the floor in a relaxed editorial posture, one knee raised, the other leg folded, one hand supporting the face and the other resting near the knee.
